name: avista-design-systems
description: Brand documents and client reports in the org's Claude Design design systems, rendered to a print-ready PDF. Lists the systems the login can reach, reads each one's real tokens and logo — following the @import chain on systems whose entry file is only imports, which is where naive parsing silently produces an unbranded document — and renders through headless Chrome so the system's web fonts actually embed. Handles view-only systems, which never enumerate via list_projects but stay fully readable by projectId.
